# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER II PRO AND CON

**[Anderson](../character/anderson.md), Moravian, Scotia** — A mysterious, massive, and rapid sea creature begins appearing globally, causing widespread public fascination and scientific debate. The situation escalates from sightings to dangerous physical collisions with ships like the [Moravian](../codex/tech.md#moravian) and the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia), leading to significant damage and public demand for the creature's removal.

## CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION

**[Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md), Abraham Lincoln** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) recounts the public debate surrounding a mysterious sea monster that damaged the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia), eventually publishing an article suggesting it is a giant narwhal. Following this, the [United States](../codex/places.md#united-states) prepares an expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt the creature. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) receives an official invitation from the Secretary of Marine to join [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) on the voyage.

## CHAPTER IV NED LAND

**[Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md)** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) decides to join the expedition to hunt the mysterious sea monster and recruits his devoted servant, [Conseil](../character/conseil.md). They board the frigate [The Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), where [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) meets [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md). The ship then departs from [Brooklyn](../codex/places.md#brooklyn), cheered on by crowds as it heads out into the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).

## CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE

**[Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md)** — As the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) travels toward the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), the crew remains vigilant and eager to hunt the mysterious sea monster. Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) engages the skeptical harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) in a debate, using scientific principles of deep-sea pressure to argue that such a powerful creature could indeed exist and cause the damage reported by ships like the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia).

## CHAPTER VI AT FULL STEAM

**[Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — The crew of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) spends months fruitlessly searching the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) for the mysterious monster, leading to growing frustration and a near-mutiny. [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) eventually promises to abandon the search and return to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) if the creature is not found within three days. Just as the deadline expires on the final night, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spots the target from the deck.

## CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE

**[Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Abraham Lincoln** — The crew of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) engages in a high-speed, day-long pursuit of a mysterious, glowing marine creature that defies their attempts to catch or strike it. After failing to hit the beast with cannon fire, the ship approaches the seemingly sleeping creature at night. [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) successfully throws his harpoon, but the creature retaliates with a massive surge of water that causes a collision and throws Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) overboard.

## CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After being thrown overboard from the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), the narrator is rescued by [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and eventually finds [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) clinging to the back of a mysterious, metallic submarine vessel. The three men realize the 'monster' they were hunting is actually a man-made craft. As the vessel begins to submerge, they are discovered by masked men and pulled inside.

## CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md)** — After being abducted and locked in a dark, iron-walled cabin, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are visited by two mysterious men whose language they cannot identify. Despite their attempts to communicate in multiple languages, the strangers remain silent and eventually leave. The captives are later provided with a meal, which they eat before falling into a deep sleep.

## CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After waking from a long sleep in their cell, the prisoners realize the submarine has surfaced to ventilate. As time passes without food, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) grows increasingly agitated and eventually attacks the steward when he finally arrives. The scene ends abruptly when the steward speaks to them in French, demanding they listen.

## CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals his identity to Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), explaining that they are now his prisoners on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Despite their lack of freedom, he offers them a tour of the vessel and shares a meal consisting entirely of marine-sourced food. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) expresses his deep disdain for terrestrial society and his profound love for the independence found beneath the sea.

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) gives Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) a tour of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), showing him a vast library, a museum-like drawing room filled with art and natural specimens, and the living quarters. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) explains his detachment from the world and his personal collection of treasures, while [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) expresses his growing fascination with the vessel and its mysterious captain.

## CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) gives Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) a detailed tour of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), explaining how electricity derived from sea water powers the vessel's systems, navigation, and machinery. They inspect the ship's layout, including the small boat, kitchen, and engine room, before [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to the saloon to discuss the mechanics of depth control.

## CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) provides Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) with a detailed technical explanation of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), describing its construction, propulsion, and navigation systems. He explains how he secretly built the vessel using parts sourced globally and asserts his immense wealth and complete confidence in the submarine's design. The conversation concludes with [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) marveling at the Captain's singular nature and the technological wonder of the ship.

## CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) takes the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to the surface to fix their position before setting a course through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). Later, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) shows [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) the wonders of the sea through the saloon's viewing panels, where they observe various marine life. The chapter concludes with [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) reflecting on the mysterious life of the Captain while the vessel continues its journey.

## CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md)** — After several days of isolation, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) to a hunting expedition at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). Before departing, the Captain explains the advanced technology they will use, including [Rouquayrol](../codex/tech.md#rouquayrol) diving apparatus and electric air-guns, to survive and hunt in the submarine environment. The group then prepares to don their specialized gear for the excursion.

## CHAPTER XVI A SUBMARINE FOREST

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Rouquayrol, Ruhmkorff** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on an underwater excursion, equipping them with specialized diving gear and air-powered guns. After exiting the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a water-tight chamber, the group walks across the sea floor, observing the vibrant marine life and vegetation. The excursion concludes as they reach the forest of the Island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).

## CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus, Ruhmkorff** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads the narrator and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on an extensive underwater excursion through a submarine forest near the Island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). During the journey, they hunt marine life, encounter dangerous sea creatures, and use electric lamps to navigate the depths before safely returning to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

## CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), France, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) observes the daily routines and scientific observations conducted by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and his crew aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) as they traverse the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). During their journey, they pass landmarks like Hawaii and the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas), collecting specimens and studying the ocean's depths. The chapter concludes with a somber discovery when the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) encounters the wreckage of a sunken ship, the Florida, containing the preserved bodies of its crew.

## CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), eventually arriving at [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), the site of the [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) shipwreck. The narrator recounts the history of the search for the lost vessels, after which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals he has discovered the final resting place of the survivors' makeshift boat and possesses the original naval instructions from the expedition.

## CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Gilboa, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) runs aground on a reef near the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains calm and expresses confidence that the upcoming full moon's tide will refloat the vessel. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) receive permission from the Captain to go ashore to hunt for fresh game. The trio successfully reaches the island, with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) eager to find land-based food.

## CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) spend two days exploring the island of [Papua](../codex/places.md#papua), hunting for game and gathering tropical fruits to supplement their diet on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). After a successful hunt that includes capturing a bird of paradise and several kangaroos, the trio enjoys a feast on the shore and briefly contemplates not returning to the ship before their conversation is interrupted by a mysterious stone thrown at them.

## CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA”

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Papuans** — After being chased back to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) by hostile [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans), Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and his companions wait for the ship to refloat. Despite the surrounding natives, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains unconcerned and eventually prepares the vessel to depart the coral reef, inviting [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to witness how he will handle the boarders.

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), Papuans** — As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) prepares to depart the coral reef, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals that the ship's exterior railings are electrified to repel the surrounding [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans). [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) accidentally experiences the shock himself, and the vessel successfully breaks free from the reef to sail away, leaving the terrified attackers behind.

## CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean) while Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) conducts deep-sea temperature experiments and the passengers observe a phosphorescent sea. Tensions rise when Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) spots something on the horizon, leading him to abruptly confine [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) to their cabin. The three men are then drugged via their breakfast, causing them to fall into a deep, forced sleep as the submarine changes its behavior.

## Chapter 25

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After waking up to find his companions and himself back in their rooms, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) is summoned by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) to treat a mortally wounded crewman. Following the man's death, the Captain leads [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a submarine excursion to a coral forest, where they hold a solemn funeral service to bury the deceased crew member in an underwater cemetery.
